item.title: 'Quad God' Ilia Malinin falls twice in a disastrous Olympic free skate
item.description: <p>MILAN — Ilia Malinin, the American figure skating sensation known as the "Quad God," proved to be a mere mortal after all.</p><p>The 21-year-old from Northern Virginia fell twice during a disastrous free skate at the Milan Cortina Olympics on Friday night, sending him tumbling all the way off the podium and allowing Mikhail Shaidorov of Kazakhstan to claim a stunning gold medal.</p><p>"I blew it," Malinin said afterward, poised and magnanimous in defeat.
